fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole car, a 2006 Chrysler 300C sedan, in the cars by owner section.
findings: Hazy, smudged film and water spotting on the trunk lid paint above the HEMI badge
HEMI badge insert looks cloudy and dull
Paint on the side panels looks flat rather than glossy in both exterior shots
Light soiling and wear on the tan leather driver and passenger seat bolsters
Clutter in the center console cupholder area and a phone mount on the dash
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2006 Chrysler 300C. It looks well kept, but the trunk lid around the HEMI badge shows some haze and spotting, and the tan leather seats could use a cleaning and conditioning. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a wash, light buff and interior clean, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
